title: Registered latent-state to acoustic-onset association
primary_outcome: Within-night difference in independently recorded acoustic-onset probability between the predefined physiology target window and matched control windows
randomization_plan: Control offsets and any target remapping are fixed before confirmation data are inspected.
blinding_plan: Event extraction is frozen; condition labels remain masked until data quality gates pass.

sample_size_or_stopping_rule.stopping_rule: Collect the preregistered number of usable nights; do not stop for significance.

inclusion_rules: All required channels and calibration records are present
Clock uncertainty passes the registered gate
exclusion_rules: Registered movement or respiration confound near target
statistical_model: Within-night target-minus-control risk difference with exact sign test across nights
multiple_testing_policy: One primary target, outcome, lag, and effect threshold; decoy analyses are negative controls.
missing_data_policy: Exclude only preregistered corrupt intervals; fail if required channels or calibrations are absent.
failure_conditions: Clock or channel quality gate failure
Positive control failure before human confirmation
safety_constraints: Any intervention must be hearing-safe and independently reviewed
Synthetic fixtures cannot be scientific evidence
